Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The Llama 3 Herd of Models (2407.21783v1) · paper method: The Llama 3 DPO recipe masks header and termination tokens from both chosen and rejected response losses to stabilize training.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

The Llama 3 Herd of Models (2407.21783v1) · paper method: The authors report that Llama 3 405B and GPT-4-0125 win rates are within the margin of error on nearly all capabilities in their human evaluation.

cohort5.claim.llama3.human-result

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific reported method or result; no experiment, proof, raw-corpus record or labor audit was independently reproduced.
  • About 7,000 prompts across capability sets; pairwise seven-point preference ratings. This is not an across-provider or present-day ranking.
